The '''Shak Monastery''' was a [[Monastery/Legends|monastery]] in [[Al-Campur]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]], where the devotees of [[Am-Shak/Legends|Am-Shak]], the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Deity/Legends|God of thunder]], once made sacrifices.<ref name="LoNH" />
